title: Emsisoft Blocks 100% in AVLab’s Latest Advanced In-The-Wild Malware Test
content_md: AVLab's September test evaluated 16 products against live in-the-wild malware. Emsisoft blocked all 417 samples and averaged 3.365 seconds from execution attempt to full cleanup. The post Emsisoft Blocks 100% in AVLab’s Latest Advanced In-The-Wild Malware Test appeared first on Emsisoft | Cybersecurity Blog .
